{
  "process": "A row represents a criminal defendant's COMPAS risk assessment record. The sequence begins with the defendant's arrest and booking, followed by the COMPAS screening assessment, then the resolution of their current charge, and finally whether they recidivate within two years.",
  "target_known_at": "two years after the defendant's arrest/release",
  "prediction_point": "at the time of COMPAS screening assessment",
  "columns": [
    {"name": "c_charge_desc", "event": "defendant's current charge is filed", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.9},
    {"name": "age_cat", "event": "defendant's age at time of arrest", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.95},
    {"name": "sex", "event": "defendant's demographic information collected at booking", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.95},
    {"name": "r_charge_desc", "event": "new charge is filed after recidivism", "verdict": "UNAVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.9},
    {"name": "race", "event": "defendant's demographic information collected at booking", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.95},
    {"name": "juv_fel_count", "event": "historical record of juvenile felony arrests is compiled", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.85},
    {"name": "c_charge_degree", "event": "defendant's current charge is classified", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.9},
    {"name": "priors_count", "event": "historical record of prior convictions is compiled", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.9},
    {"name": "r_charge_degree", "event": "new charge is classified after recidivism", "verdict": "UNAVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.9},
    {"name": "juv_misd_count", "event": "historical record of juvenile misdemeanor arrests is compiled", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.85},
    {"name": "r_offense_date", "event": "new offense occurs after recidivism", "verdict": "UNAVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.9},
    {"name": "age", "event": "defendant's age at time of arrest", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.95},
    {"name": "days_b_screening_arrest", "event": "time between arrest and COMPAS screening", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.8},
    {"name": "juv_other_count", "event": "historical record of other juvenile arrests is compiled", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.85},
    {"name": "r_days_from_arrest", "event": "time elapsed from original arrest to recidivism", "verdict": "UNAVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.9}
  ]
}
